BiblicalUsage: The word is used once, and it is the ascension: when the time was come that He should be received up, Jesus steadfastly set His face to go to Jerusalem. It is the noun for the taking up itself — the moment the road turns toward Jerusalem and the cross, because the time of His receiving up has come.
TheologicalSignificance: One word for the taking up carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the set face — Jesus turning toward Jerusalem because His ascension was coming.
